# Blue Leaf Hub — Template Master Audit

**Audit date:** 2026-06-21  
**Scope:** Full codebase, all modules, all document types  
**Auditor:** Claude Code (automated + code inspection)  
**Status:** Draft — awaiting Sam review before any build begins

---

## 1. Executive Summary

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Existing templates / generators found | 32 |
| Missing templates identified | 47 |
| Critical missing (blocks workflow) | 14 |
| Templates currently hardcoded in server routes | 18 |
| Documents being created manually outside Hub | ~12 (estimated) |

### Top 5 risks from template gaps

1. **No contract document** — HIA/MBA contract is prepared and signed entirely outside the Hub, with no record, version control or audit trail inside the system
2. **Selections process has no template** — clients are selecting finishes via email/phone with no formal approval record; this is the #1 variation cause in construction
3. **No client onboarding document** — after PTSA is signed and a job is created, there is no structured welcome pack or commencement communication
4. **Progress claim email is hardcoded plain text** — `<pre style="font-family:sans-serif">` is the current format; no proper HTML template, no branding, high risk of clients ignoring it
5. **Handover / practical completion has no workflow** — no checklist, no defect capture, no warranty documentation. End of project is a whitespace in the Hub

## 6. Template Risk Register

### R1 — Critical legal/contractual risk
| Risk | Missing template | Impact if not built | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| SOPA non-compliance | Overdue payment notice (formal) | Cannot enforce Security of Payment Act entitlements | **Critical** |
| No signed proposal acceptance | Proposal acceptance letter | Client can dispute they agreed to the proposal price | **Critical** |
| No PC notice issued | Practical completion notice | Defect liability period and final payment cannot be formally triggered | **Critical** |
| No contract record in Hub | Contract cover sheet + signing record | No audit trail; fact registry `original_contract_value` cannot be stamped correctly | **Critical** |

### R2 — WHS / safety risk
| Risk | Missing/incomplete area | Impact | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| WHS docs exist but UI is missing | WHS markdown templates + render engine exist; no builder-facing generation UI | Supervisors are generating WHS docs externally or not at all | **Critical** |
| Subcontractor compliance not tracked | Compliance request email + expiry automation | Insurance lapses go unnoticed; public liability exposure | **High** |

### R3 — Payment / cashflow risk
| Risk | Missing template | Impact | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claims ignored | Proper branded HTML claim email (current is `<pre>` plain text) | Clients treat plain-text claims as informal; delayed payment | **High** |
| No automated chase | Payment reminder (5 days) + overdue notice (14 days) | Cashflow impact; no paper trail for SOPA | **High** |
| No payment confirmation | Payment receipt email | Clients double-pay or dispute what was received | **Medium** |

### R4 — Client experience / trust risk
| Risk | Missing template | Impact | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Client never onboarded | Client onboarding welcome email + pack | First impression post-contract is silence | **Critical** |
| No portal invite | Portal invite email | Clients never access the portal Blue Leaf built for them | **Critical** |
| No weekly updates | Weekly update email template | Clients feel out of the loop; trust erodes | **High** |
| No selections process | Selections schedule + approval email | #1 source of disputes and variations | **Critical** |
| End of project is silence | Completion thank-you + testimonial request | Missed referral opportunities | **Medium** |

### R5 — Operational / duplicate-entry risk
| Risk | Missing template | Impact | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Meeting decisions undocumented | Meeting minutes | Verbal decisions disputed later; no action register | **High** |
| Appliances/finishes not recorded | Appliance/finishes register | Clients ask "what brand was that?" → manual research | **Medium** |
| PTSA hardcoded in server | Extract PTSA base64 to template file | Cannot update template without code deployment | **High** |
| 18 email templates hardcoded | All emails in section 2D | Cannot update wording without code deployment | **Medium** |

## 8. Recommended Template Architecture

### By format

| Format | Use for | Where in repo |
|---|---|---|
| **DOCX merge template** (docxtemplater) | Client-facing documents that need professional layout: fee proposals, PTSA, acceptance letter, PC notice, warranty pack, handover checklist | `docs/templates/*.docx` |
| **Server-generated PDF** (PDFKit) | Documents that need to be reliably rendered without client editing: progress claims, variations, POs, inductions, WHS docs, incident reports | `server/lib/*PdfKit.mjs` — each module gets its own file |
| **HTML email template** | Client-facing emails that need branding and links | `server/lib/emailTemplates/` — new directory, one file per email type |
| **Markdown + merge fields** | WHS documents that need to be editable by non-developers (SWMS, registers, plans) | `docs/whs/template-pack/` — already exists |
| **React form → DB record** | Selections approvals, variation sign-offs, defect reports, meeting minutes | Client portal + Hub — stored as structured DB records, not files |
| **Portal record** | Weekly updates, messages, decisions, milestones | `projects` / `portal_updates` tables — already exists |

### Naming convention

```
docs/templates/
  [module]-[document-type]-[variant].docx
  
  Examples:
  presales-ptsa-v2.docx
  presales-proposal-acceptance-letter.docx
  finance-progress-claim-v1.docx
  handover-practical-completion-notice.docx
  handover-warranty-pack.docx
  handover-checklist.docx

server/lib/emailTemplates/
  enquiryConfirmation.mjs
  portalInvite.mjs
  progressClaimSent.mjs
  variationSent.mjs
  paymentReminder.mjs
  paymentOverdueNotice.mjs
  constructionCommencementNotice.mjs
  weeklyClientUpdate.mjs
  completionThankyou.mjs
  testimonialRequest.mjs
  ...
```

### Versioning

- All DOCX templates: version number in filename (`-v1`, `-v2`)
- PDF generators: version tracked in git; breaking changes get new function names
- Email templates: version tracked in git; each has a `templateVersion` constant at top of file

### Before a template goes live

1. Legal review: any financial, SOPA, contract, or WHS document must be reviewed before first use
2. Sam sign-off: client-facing documents need director approval
3. Test with a dummy job: render with Q1196 data, check all merge fields resolve
4. SOP written: every template needs a matching SOP section in the relevant `docs/sops/XX_*/` folder
